svg.metadata: Primary target geometry: Natural Earth 1:10m BHS cultural vectors, public domain, via LonnyGomes/CountryGeoJSONCollection. Hawksbill Cay (Scene 5) and Elbow Cay / Hope Town (Scene 6) shoreline geometry supplemented from GSHHG/GSHHS intermediate resolution via Basemap 2.0.0. Nassau detail inset follows the established Qatar locator/inset treatment: the national map remains unchanged, a locator box and guide identify the source area, and the inset uses the same WGS84 New Providence geometry. 1200×760; reviewed 2026-09-25.
